crates.name: velocity_mcp
crates.role: High-performance zero-allocation NMCP server with dual-mode protocol (JSON-RPC stdio + shared memory binary)

key_constraints: Dual-protocol execution: stdio JSON-RPC v2.0 and shared memory NMCP binary
Zero-allocation binary frame parsing via raw slice alignment
Memory-mapped file IPC with atomic state machine ring buffer (64KB total)
C# NdaMcpServer delegation for tool execution (convert_to_nda, read_nda, execute_nda)
SHA-256 Merkle signatures on NMCP binary frames (32-byte merkle root)
Release profile: opt-level 3, LTO, codegen-units 1, panic abort, stripped
Self-contained single executable — no dynamic dependencies
